name: The Gordunni Scroll
summary: At the Gordunni Outpost, the Gordunni Scroll may reveal a gathering or ceremony. Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants to see it and learn what it means for the Gordunni.

sections.title: The Soiled Scroll
sections.body: You find a soiled scroll at the Gordunni Outpost. Its image seems to show a gathering or ceremony. Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants to see it and learn what it might mean for the Gordunni.

faq.q: What does the Gordunni Scroll show?
faq.answer: The Gordunni Scroll seems to show a meeting or ceremony.

aliases: where do i take the scroll
faq.answer: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache wants to see the Gordunni Scroll.

faq.q: Where is the Gordunni Scroll found?
faq.answer: You find the Gordunni Scroll at the Gordunni Outpost.
